name: io.github.tanya-ok/hipaa-fhir-mcp
title: HIPAA FHIR MCP (prototype)
description: Prototype: three read-only FHIR R4 tools with HMAC audit. Synthetic data only, not for real PHI.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIT_HMAC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 64 hex characters used to HMAC patient ids in audit records

environmentVariables.name: FHIR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: FHIR R4 base URL; defaults to the public synthetic SMART sandbox

environmentVariables.name: CALLER_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Operator label written into audit records, not an authenticated identity

environmentVariables.name: AUDIT_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path for the audit file sink; stderr when empty
